_about: Patristic and spiritual works ingested from the Christian Classics Ethereal Library (CCEL), which publishes these public-domain texts for download as ThML. Add a work here and run `npm run data:all` to ingest it. `scriptureMode` says how verse links are derived: 'tractates' / 'psalm-roman' / 'john-dot' read the work's own section titles (structure-based, strongest); 'tags' uses scripture references tagged inside the text (machine-tagged: the text cites the passage, it is not necessarily a commentary on it).

works.title: Tractates on the Gospel of John
works.author: Augustine of Hippo
works.description: Augustine's running homilies on John, including the great Eucharistic tractates 25–27 on John 6.
works.translator: Rev. John Gibb (Tractates 1–37) and Rev. James Innes (Tractates 38–124), for Dods' Series of Augustin's Works; ed. Philip Schaff, NPNF 1st series vol. 7 (1888)
works.rightsEvidence: Translators named in the volume's preface; 1880s publication.

_excluded.john-cross-dark-night: CCEL edition is E. Allison Peers' 20th-century translation; its US/EU status could not be verified, so it is not imported.
_excluded.desales-devout-life: CCEL record states no rights or translator; not imported until the translation and its date are verified.
_excluded.kempis-imitation: CCEL edition is a 1949 translation (Croft & Bolt). CCEL marks it Public Domain, but a 1949 translation is not obviously so; not imported until verified.
